items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1964-03-21
items.q: And after I stopped playing Chris Kelly, I played with several big bands in the city.

ctx.x: Well. No. Sammy Penn. Only chance Sammy Penn got. He was on his own. Because I'm a good boy.

Fall off. Yeah. Okay. When were you born? I was born in September. September the 15th. 1902. And where? In Morgan City, Louisiana. And did you play any music out there at all? That's where I started at. I started playing in Morgan City. When I started playing music. It's a funny thing to tell you. What I'm going to tell you. I started. I had one of those cheese boxes. For snare drum. And a white tub. They call it. For a bass drum. And a fellow made me some springs. For a pedal. Made a pedal. That's how I started…

items.title: Sammy Penn Interview, 1960-04-21
items.q: So after he died, the fellas just dropped out and got in other different bands. So that's why I went and started playing with Chris Kelly a while.

ctx.x: a drummer. Well what happened to Buddy's band after he took that second stroke? What actually happened with the band?

Well, what happened to the band, we just played a while and didn't get much work. What we used to get when Buddy was living. So the men began to drop out. In fact, Buddy was well known and Buddy used to get plenty of work. So after he died, the fellas just dropped out and got in other different bands. So that's why I went and started playing with Chris Kelly a while.
Oh, that was when you joined Chris Kelly. Yeah. From Buddy. Mm-hm.
